summary: A-Z list with 1483 anime and 8-source video fallback system implemented. Type mapping and localStorage work correctly, but 6 of 8 video sources return search URLs instead of playable embeds, iframe timeout cleanup is incomplete, and errors are silently suppressed.

findings.issue: Video sources 3-8 (Rumble, Odysee, OK.ru variants) return search page URLs that cannot play in iframes, breaking the auto-fallback system after the first two sources fail
findings.suggestion: Remove non-functional sources 3-8 or implement server-side scraping to extract actual embed URLs from search results. Document that only Primary and Dailymotion are currently functional.

findings.issue: iframeErrorTimeoutRef timeout is not cleared in useEffect cleanup or when loadPrimaryStream runs, causing stale 'Video not playing?' prompts to appear after navigation or episode changes
findings.suggestion: Add clearTimeout(iframeErrorTimeoutRef.current) to the useEffect cleanup return statement and at the top of loadPrimaryStream before setting a new timeout

findings.issue: localStorage save/load operations use empty catch blocks that silently suppress all errors, making it impossible to debug when localStorage is blocked or full
findings.suggestion: Replace empty catch blocks with console.warn() statements: catch (err) { console.warn('Failed to save video source preference:', err) }

findings.issue: mapAnimeType function defaults all unrecognized anime_type values to 'anime', which will silently misclassify catalog entries with typos or unexpected type values (e.g., 'OVA', 'special')
findings.suggestion: Add console.warn() for unrecognized type values before returning the default 'anime' classification to surface catalog data issues during development
